question_title: Will any of Belgium, France, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, and/or Germany leave the EU before 2027?
reasoning: As of 26 Nov 2026, none of the six states has triggered Article 50 TEU, and no exit referendum is scheduled in any of them. The UK is the only state ever to withdraw (left 31 Jan 2020). Article 50 requires notification to the European Council, after which the Treaties cease to apply only on entry into force of a withdrawal agreement or two years after notification, so even a notification today could not produce an exit before 2027. Frexit remains campaign rhetoric: Florian Philippot's 14 Nov 2026 Paris rally drew a few hundred people, and France's presidential election is in spring 2027, after this question's window. Kalshi prices a French EU-exit referendum before 2030 at only 3%. With about 5 weeks left in 2026 and no notification, no referendum, and no government pursuing exit in any of the six states, the chance of any of them leaving the EU before 2027 is at the floor: 1%.
